'''Hawra''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] serving as the commander of security at the [[Lotide]] [[Technical Branch Outpost (Lotide)|Technical Branch Outpost]].

==Personality and traits==
An outwardly cheery and outgoing man, Hawra was said to be one of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] most ruthless and ambitious officers. Paranoid and corrupt, his main priority was to gain power and ensure his own safety. While climbing through the ranks, he would use anyone who got in his way, stepping over them when the time came for promotions. Hawra suspected that [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Pora]] was targeting him, and was arranging an "accident" for Pora in a weapons lab.<ref name="BI" />

When a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] agents [[Mission to Lotide|infiltrated]] the tech post posing as [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] from [[Dakot Seven]], Hawra questioned each in turn, asking leading questions in order to find out if they were Alliance [[Spy/Legends|spies]].<ref name="BI" />
